# Pomodoro Timer
> A free, browser-based Pomodoro productivity timer.

This is a free online Pomodoro technique timer. It helps users stay focused
using 25-minute work sessions followed by short breaks. No account required.

## Features
- 25-minute Pomodoro work sessions
- 5-minute short breaks
- 15-minute long breaks after 4 sessions
- Session counter
- Clean, distraction-free interface
- Works in any modern web browser

## The Pomodoro Technique
The Pomodoro Technique was created by Francesco Cirillo in the 1980s.
It breaks work into focused 25-minute intervals separated by short breaks,
improving concentration and reducing mental fatigue.
